issues.fix: Set website to blank (or mark 'dead domain'), keep address/phone from the borough directory, and treat as one-directory-only entry.

issues.claim: Gray's Florist, 1 N Main St, Manville, (908) 429-1004 (group D, florist)
issues.problem: 1 N Main St is the Royal Farms convenience store address in Manville (per the borough directory and Royal Farms listings), and Gray's Florist's own current site lists only Watchung and Bridgewater locations. The Manville listing (davesgarden) looks stale; the shop does not appear to operate in the zone.
issues.fix: Drop the entry, or downgrade to 'unverified/possibly closed' and do not include it in outreach.

issues.claim: Klean Kutz, 809 S Main St, Manville — listed as an active barbershop
issues.problem: Klean Kutz's own website says the Manville shop is temporarily closed due to flooding and directs customers to its Middlesex and South Plainfield shops. Listed as active with no flag.
issues.fix: Keep but flag as temporarily closed in Manville; deprioritise until the shop reopens.

issues.claim: Manville Maytag Repair, 25 S Main St #P12, (908) 864-2884 (group D)
issues.problem: No independent confirmation that this exists as a local business. The borough listing's URL is an appliance-repair lead-generation site (appliancerepairsomersetcounty.com) and no Maytag-authorized Manville servicer could be found; the address is a small mail-drop-style unit.
issues.fix: Drop, or reclassify as 'lead-gen listing / not a real local business' before any outreach.

issues.fix: Keep as single-source but note the competing address and possibly inactive registration; verify address/phone before contacting.

issues.claim: Jeff Alte Roofing Inc, 229 N Main St, Suite 1, Manville — website https://alteroofing.com/
issues.problem: Website and phone (908-850-8558) confirm the company, but its contact page lists 'Main Office: 1280 NJ-57, Port Murray, NJ' plus a Bergen County office — no Manville office is shown. The Manville suite comes from the borough self-registration list only, so the in-zone operating address is unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Keep the business but re-label the Manville address as 'registered/borough-listed address; offices per own site are Port Murray and Ridgefield Park' and verify before door-level outreach.

issues.problem: Address was left blank although it is publicly listed: 255 N Main St, Manville, (908) 526-2224 (a2zdentalcare.com).
issues.fix: Fill in 255 N Main St, Manville, NJ 08835 and phone (908) 526-2224.

issues.problem: Healthgrades lists the Manville practice at 313 S Main St under Dr. William Schroeder, DC. Cindy may be a co-practitioner or office staff; only the phone/address are corroborated.
issues.fix: Change contact label to 'William Schroeder, DC (Cindy Schroeder also associated)' or drop the practitioner name.

issues.claim: Category gap: law firms ('only two Manville offices found')
issues.problem: At least two further Manville law offices are publicly listed and were missed: Blumberg & Rosenberg, 203 S Main St Suite 2, (908) 725-0272, and Joseph V. Feltri, 3 Garry St. The thin-category note overstates the gap.
issues.fix: Add both (group A) and correct the categories_thin note about attorneys.

issues.problem: Milltown Plumbing & Heating (Manville-based, 908-295-8279) and Pat Di Monte Plumbing & Heating LLC (Manville, Angi profile) are eligible local trades missing from the list. Separately, Bradford White's contractor finder shows 'Coast Plumbing, Heating & Drain Cleaning' at 1335 Bleecher St — the same address as the listed Kevin Cichon Plumbing, so that is probably the same firm under a trade name and should be merged rather than double-counted.
issues.fix: Add Milltown Plumbing and Pat Di Monte to group C; note the Cichon/Coast Plumbing address match under the Cichon entry.

issues.problem: Three further Manville landscaping firms are publicly listed: King Landscaping, Inc. (Houzz, Manville), ABL Landscaping LLC (site says Manville-based, NJ HIC 13VH11485100) and A.R.B Landscaping (Nextdoor, Manville). Only Landscape Creations and two tree services were captured.
issues.fix: Add the three to group C and re-check the yellowpages Manville landscape-contractors category.

issues.problem: Somerville Martial Arts Academy Inc. is listed at 99 N 13th Ave, Manville, (908) 801-6528 — the same address used for Polska Szkola — and is not in the list (only Three Rivers Dojo and Red Dragon were found).
issues.fix: Add to group B; note the shared address with Polska Szkola.

issues.claim: Polska Szkola (Polish School), 99 N 13th Ave — group D 'language/cultural school'
issues.problem: Borderline exclusion: it is literally a school. Dance/music/driving instruction entries were treated as commercial businesses, but a language school may fall under the mapper's 'schools' exclusion, so the list is inconsistent as coded.
issues.fix: Confirm with the owner's rules; if 'schools' excludes it, drop Polska Szkola (and decide the same way for Somerset Driving School and Main Street Dance & Music).

issues.problem: About 60 entries rest on a single self-registration or lead-gen directory. Sampling confirms most are real (U R Home Realty, Couch Accounting, Pettoni, Frank J. Bongiorno, MFA Roofing, OTX, Roe Industries) but two sampled entries turned out stale (Gray's Florist, Manville Maytag Repair), so the tail needs the same check.
issues.fix: Before outreach, spot-check the remaining single-source entries the same way (own-site phone match or a second independent directory).
